---
title: "Explanation"
---

Explanation is **understanding-oriented**: discussion that contextualises
what you are doing and why — the *background* that tutorials, how-to
guides, and reference deliberately leave out (one of the four modes of
the [Diátaxis](https://diataxis.fr) framework [@procidadiataxis]).

## Available explanations

### [Definition of the state of health](definition-of-health.qmd)

The project's provisional definition (v0.1): domains, boundaries, the
proxy-versus-construct discipline, resolution, and the revision process.

### [Defining health](defining-health.qmd)

Why "state of health" needs a definition before it can be measured, and
what the definition must pin down.

### [Health is not stationary](nonstationarity.qmd)

Why the project treats health as a dynamic, nonstationary quantity — and
what that rules out at every stage of the analysis.

### [Why BC only?](why-bc.qmd)

The scope decision behind limiting this project to British Columbia —
and why explanatory data from outside BC still counts.

## Planned explanations

- **What the data can and cannot say** — coverage, suppression, and
  definitional breaks in BC health data (milestone M2).
- **Dependence vs. causation in health data** — why correlation
  analyses are a waypoint, not a destination (milestones M4–M5).
- **How recommendations are graded** — evidence strength, uncertainty,
  and equity impact (milestone M6).
